# Todo Tracking

- The workspace root `todo.md` holds the active plan(s). Read it before starting any task.
- For any multi-step task: add the goal, decisions, and every task as an unchecked `- [ ]` item with short details (files, acceptance criteria).
- Keep `todo.md` current: check off items only when actually finished; keep one task in-progress at a time.
- When a task is complete, flip `- [ ]` → `- [x]` in `todo.md`.
- Do not abandon `todo.md` mid-project for a chat-only plan dump.
